stage0007a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ボス$$
「Whew, nice weather!
　Perfect day for a hike!」

stage0007a_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Fair enough.
　Let our classmates enjoy nature to the fullest.」

stage0007a_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$ is on $$宗介$$ and $$正太郎$$.
　We'll carry out our own mission...
　to protect $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0007a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$甲児$$
「Look who's talking.
　You just think hiking's a drag.」

stage0007a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...So that was the plan all along.」

stage0007a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アルト$$
「Why is Miss $$スズネ$$ here!?」

stage0007a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クラン$$ and $$ルカ$$ told me.
　That you all gave up on the hike
　and stayed to protect this city...」

stage0007a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So I thought I'd come too, but...
　you just wanted to play hooky...」

stage0007a_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know if I'm sad or ashamed of myself...」

stage0007a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$甲児$$
「N-no... it's only $$アルト$$
　who's thinking that way...」

stage0007a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's low, $$甲児$$!
　Playing the good kid all by yourself!」

stage0007a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about, $n!
　It was you who said in the first place
　you weren't going on the hike!」

stage0007a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All of you, stop it...!
　I'm honestly about to cry!」

stage0007a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I know the Defense Force's work matters,
　and that it's hard, but you're still
　high schoolers, act like students too.」

stage0007a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Being a student means going hiking...?）

stage0007a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
（Could you say that to Miss $$スズネ$$'s face right now?）

stage0007a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Studying, doing club activities,
　hanging out with friends, falling in love...」

stage0007a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I want you all to experience things like that,
　in these peaceful times.
　This moment won't come again.」

stage0007a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　We... may have been treating
　going to Jindai High as half a joke.」

stage0007a_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Our real job is fighting...
　school life's more like a cover, I guess...」

stage0007a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Which one you prioritize
　should be your own choice, I think.」

stage0007a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But I still want you all
　to give your best at both.」

stage0007a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'll prove I can handle both...
　fighting and school. Betting my youth on it.」

stage0007a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$さやか$$
「Thinking it over, $$ワッ太$$'s pretty impressive.
　Working hard as both President and grade schooler.」

stage0007a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「True enough.
　Can't let him show us up.」

stage0007a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Good.
　There's a school trip next month too,
　so let's enjoy it to the fullest.」

stage0007a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, under my watch today,
　let's make the most of student life.」

stage0007a_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$スズネ$$
「There's a movie I want to see...
　would you come along with me?」

stage0007a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「Well then, since we've got the chance,
　let's head downtown!」

stage0007a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「By the way, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　what movie did you want to see?」

stage0007a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「'Celestial Being', it's all the rage now.」
